name: aiwa-reference-tests
description: Test-only devDependencies for AIWA's JS test suite. The deployed app (public/) has NO build step and loads @solana/web3.js from a CDN at runtime (see solana-wallet.js's loadSolanaWeb3()) — this package.json exists solely so tests/solana-wallet.test.mjs can exercise the real library offline, with real transaction construction/signing, rather than a hand-rolled fake. "type": "module" only affects how Node resolves these .js files during testing — it has no effect on the deployed app, which the browser loads directly and knows nothing about this file.
